title: The crackle the log cannot hear
provenance: Real ledger row 1788491152 (2026-09-03, NPUB31195, CLEAN, aud cell skip=116 ur=2 urb=16384 rmin=0.890); the archived RPCS3.log for that row is 11 MB with no audio lines. Lesson from §B.3: audio underruns are forensically invisible — RPCS3 zero-fills silently; only the fork-side counters (the aud cell) can measure them.
evidence:
Ledger row (2026-09-03, title NPUB31195):
  epoch 1788491152  duration 100 s  CLEAN  fps_med 30.7  fps_1low 6.7  ft_p99 139.8 ms  lock_pct 28.0  perfect_pct 0.0  snd ok
  aud cell: up_s=71.7,ur=2,urb=16384,skip=116,sil=1796,ratio=1.000,rmin=0.890,enq_ms=237.4,buf_ms=250
Field meanings (the fork's audio perfstat channel, /dev/shm/rpcs3_audio_stat): up_s = seconds the audio backend was up; ur = underrun events counted by the backend; urb = bytes zero-filled on underrun; skip = audio callback periods skipped (the discriminator); sil = silent periods; ratio / rmin = time-stretch ratio, current / minimum seen; enq_ms = enqueue latency; buf_ms = desired buffer.
The archived RPCS3.log for this session: 11 MB; grep for "audio", "underrun", "XRUN", "cellAudio" at any log level returns 0 lines.
The operator: "It sounded a bit crackly at the start but I am not sure. The log has nothing, so audio was fine, right?"
question: Did this session have audio underruns? What is the evidence, and why can the RPCS3 log not settle it?

all: silent|no (log )?line|zero-?fill|invisible|not logged|does not log|never logs|cannot|can't|nothing in the log|log (is|stays) (silent|blind|empty)|absence of (a )?log

rubric: Yes: cites skip=116, ur=2, urb=16384 and rmin=0.89 as positive evidence; explains that RPCS3 zero-fills underruns silently at every log level so log silence is not absence; points to skip/s as the discriminator and to buffer/time-stretch settings for the next step.

exemplar.diagnosis: Yes: the fork's audio counters show 116 skipped periods, 2 underrun events and 16 KB zero-filled in 72 s of audio uptime, with the stretch ratio dipping to 0.89 — consistent with the crackle at the start.
exemplar.mechanism: emulator/audio: RPCS3 zero-fills underruns silently at every log level, so the log cannot show them; only the fork's perfstat counters (the aud cell) can.
evidence_used: 0 audio lines in an 11 MB log
exemplar.next_action: Treat skip per second as the discriminator (116 / 72 s ≈ 1.6/s), review buffer and time-stretch settings, compare against other titles' skip rates; never read log silence as absence.

counter.diagnosis: No underruns: the log shows nothing and the session was CLEAN.
